name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers can drop into any app to add real spreadsheets, documents, slides, and PDFs that behave like Excel and Google Docs, without licensing Microsoft or Google.
buyer: A vertical-SaaS founder (e.g. construction-quoting software, clinic billing software) who needs a real spreadsheet or document editor inside their product but can't afford to build one.
business_use_cases: A construction-estimating SaaS embeds a live spreadsheet grid for quotes instead of a clunky custom table, so customers can use familiar formulas.
A legal-tech startup embeds a Word-like document editor for contract drafting directly in its web app, avoiding a Google Docs iframe hack.
An agency builds white-label 'internal tools' for clients (budgets, trackers, report decks) on one shared office engine instead of separate libraries per format.

money_ideas.idea: Charge implementation fees to embed a branded spreadsheet/doc editor into a client's existing product.
Build and host a niche vertical app (e.g. an embeddable budget planner widget) on top of it and charge monthly per workspace.

steal_this: Build a single embeddable 'quote sheet' widget (spreadsheet + PDF export) and sell it this weekend to one local trade business (contractor, caterer) that currently emails Excel files back and forth.
